streams.reasoning: From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: All components mixed prior to heating. Concentration matches batch (0.3 M). Flow rate derived from engineering calculations to achieve target residence time.

mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: All reagents dissolved together in DMF before heating. Single stream feed implies no pre-reactor mixing required, but T-mixer used if splitting streams for safety/viscosity, though here single stream is preferred. Using T-mixer as default for single stream injection into reactor coil.
pre_reactor_steps: Degas DMF solution if necessary to prevent bubble formation at high T, though air is acceptable per plan. Calculation suggests gas-liquid handling for air atmosphere, but SnAr is robust. Pre-heating loop recommended.
post_reactor_steps: Quench with water/brine. Extract with ethyl acetate. Dry over Na2SO4. Concentrate.
chemistry_notes: SnAr reaction of 4-fluoronitrobenzene with piperazine in DMF at 120 C. Reaction is kinetically controlled. Engineering calculations indicate a 10x intensification factor is achievable. BPR is required to maintain liquid phase at 120 C (DMF bp 153 C, but safety margin and potential gas evolution from impurities or air expansion necessitate pressure). Single stream feed simplifies setup. No light source needed.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Calculation: 36.0 min derived from 10x intensification of 6h batch time. Range [24-54] min. 36 min is central value.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Liquid-only basis as reaction is homogeneous liquid phase. Air atmosphere in batch does not imply gas-liquid flow regime for SnAr unless specified as gas feed. Calculation assumes liquid flow.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Same as batch (120 C) to ensure conversion. DMF is stable at this temperature.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation: 6.7 bar required. Although DMF bp is 153 C, BPR ensures single-phase flow and prevents any potential degassing or solvent loss at 120 C. Calculation explicitly mandates BPR.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: PFA preferred for thermal stability at 120 C and chemical resistance to DMF. FEP is also acceptable but PFA has higher temp rating.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: 0.3 M from batch protocol and Chemistry Plan. Maintained for direct comparison and to match calculation assumptions.
